metadata.description: skill-hub: a centralized, curated collection of Agent Skills for Claude Code, Claude.ai and the Claude API

plugins.name: git-skills
plugins.description: All 61 Git skills extracted from the Pro Git book (bundle of every git-* plugin)

plugins.name: git-getting-started
plugins.description: Git fundamentals: install and configure Git, create repositories, record changes, view history, undo mistakes, tags and aliases

plugins.name: git-branching
plugins.description: Git branching & merging: branches, merging, remote-tracking branches, rebasing, advanced merge conflicts and rerere

plugins.name: git-collaboration
plugins.description: Collaborating with Git: remotes, protocols, hosting a Git server (SSH, daemon, Smart HTTP, GitWeb), distributed workflows, GitHub and credentials

plugins.name: git-power-tools
plugins.description: Git power tools: revision selection, interactive staging, stash, signing, searching, rewriting history, reset, bisect/blame, submodules, bundles and replace

plugins.name: git-customization
plugins.description: Customizing Git: configuration, attributes, client/server hooks, enforced policies and environment variables

plugins.name: git-internals
plugins.description: Git internals: plumbing commands, objects, references, packfiles, refspecs, transfer protocols, maintenance and data recovery

plugins.name: git-integrations
plugins.description: Git with other systems and tools: Git as an SVN/Mercurial/Perforce client, migrating to Git, PowerShell, JGit and libgit2

plugins.name: git-reference
plugins.description: Full Pro Git reference skill: chapter-by-chapter source knowledge for Git questions no focused skill covers

plugins.name: android-automation
plugins.description: Android test automation and debugging: generate keyword/resource-id locator JSON from the screen of a device or a UIAutomator XML dump (including automotive OEM head units), and analyse logcat for crashes, ANRs and service failures

plugins.name: repo-tools
plugins.description: Repositories: read a whole codebase file by file and write a LEARNINGS.md, with a script that plans the read and checks nothing was missed

plugins.name: image-tools
plugins.description: Images: read any PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF/BMP with a Python script and report pixels (exact colours, regions, palette, pixel map, CSV) plus a plain-text description, EXIF and optional OCR; with OpenCV, find icons in screenshots and compare screenshots

plugins.name: video-tools
plugins.description: Video: analyse MP4/MOV/MKV/WebM with a Python script - metadata, frames extracted as images, per-frame colours, brightness and motion, scenes, black and frozen sections, pixel colour over time, pixel CSV, and a text description and timeline

plugins.name: hub-tools
plugins.description: Skills for working with the hub itself: find and install skills, contribute new skills, generate skills from technical PDFs (skillforge) and from web pages (url-to-skill)

plugins.name: testing-tools
plugins.description: Testing: write, run and verify Kotlin unit tests class by class and method by method with Python scripts - Gradle/Maven/kotlinc runs, test-to-method mapping, quality checks (assertion-free, empty, disabled, JUnit 4 not run), coverage, mutation check, and an HTML report

plugins.name: gitlab-ci-tools
plugins.description: GitLab CI/CD: write .gitlab-ci.yml pipelines, debug failing or stuck pipelines, and make pipelines faster and cheaper
